_meta.description: Template for capturing opaque Cinema Studio 4.0 preset UUIDs extracted once from a Web Cinema Studio job.
extraction_workflow: 1. Configure camera, lens, aperture, genre, era, pacing, lighting, and palette once in https://higgsfield.ai/cinema-studio and run one reference job.
2. Inspect the completed job JSON via: higgsfield generate get <job_id> --json
3. Copy the resolved UUID fields from the job payload into docs/cinema-presets.json (or campaigns/<slug>/cinema-presets.json) and reference them from shotlist.json.
_meta.notes: Values below are illustrative RFC-4122 documentation UUIDs; replace them with live UUIDs returned by `higgsfield generate get <job_id> --json` for your workspace.

commercial_hero_macro.label: Commercial Hero Macro — Crisp Studio Key
commercial_hero_macro.visual_notes: Clean commercial macro look with shallow depth of field, controlled specular key, and neutral highlights.
